title: Dorayaki Pancake Cake
description: A traditional Japanese dessert made with dorayaki pancakes, filled with sweet red bean paste and topped with crispy almond flakes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, sugar, and water.
Add flour and whisk until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add butter and swirl to coat the pan.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter into the pan and cook until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the dorayaki and cook for another minute.
To assemble the cake, place a dorayaki on a plate and spread a tablespoon of red bean paste on top.
Repeat with the remaining dorayaki and red bean paste.
